Recorded claim:
The May module conversion kept legacy Spotlight getters that deleted and then assigned to this._profileDir and this._metadataDir. On class instances, the inherited getter-only property made that assignment throw, so a later patch initialized #profileDir and #metadataDir private fields in the constructor. The D226115 review explicitly said that this removed the console error but did not restore Spotlight search. Existing messages also needed backfill because indexing happens as messages arrive. Treat the getter fix and a working Spotlight index as separate outcomes.

Provenance: e656121f138bf7bb590a8985bb45d9e0e877511476a46d40958229e156583546. Original evidence IDs: 4f13a51b4dd0aa8869003184edeb85b8bbb72306da869c1cb658746444f3610a, aeb1d20d093ec93b85e97f3d95939dcd6ff31d7d24b4a31b9d6e49fcf051e71b, fd22be6673e3a54c2f86004db48d5f62f428d379ceb9aa29253d0327f42ad15a.
This is a recorded historical interpretation, not independent source verification. Source quotes from personal imports or unconfirmed-access records remain private. Historical test results are reported outcomes; no tests were rerun for this backfill.

title: Recorded lesson: Do not cache class getter values by assigning to a getter-only property
